description: We are a team of passionate and creative minds who believe in exploring new possibilities through technology and innovation. With curiosity, teamwork, and problem-solving skills, we aim to turn ideas into solutions that make a difference. Our mission is to think beyond boundaries and explore the universe of opportunities!
summary:
SpaceHealth AI is a team-developed project designed to address the challenges astronauts face in maintaining their physical and mental well-being during space missions. Space environments present unique health challenges, including isolation, limited medical facilities and changes in the human body's functioning. Our project aims to make health monitoring and support more accessible through an AI-powered digital platform.

As a team, we collaborated by brainstorming ideas, identifying important problems astronauts encounter, researching possible solutions and developing the portal with features intended to make health-related information easier to access and understand. Each contribution helped us combine our ideas into one platform.

The project addresses the challenge by providing a centralised digital space for astronaut health support, making information and assistance more organised and accessible. Its long-term vision is to support healthier, safer and more efficient space missions through technology and innovation.
details: SpaceHealth AI is a web portal that helps keep astronauts healthy during space missions. It shows health information in one simple dashboard and uses AI to give health guidance. This helps astronauts and mission teams spot problems early, even when contact with Earth is slow. We have built it with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It is creative because it puts health tracking and AI help in one easy place.
